description: Roll a budget Constraint up (BL-11): total of stated contributions vs the limit, the worst dependency path among contributors (the path-cumulative rollup — end-to-end latency, mass down a chain), basis coverage (estimated vs measured), and an honest verdict — `incomplete` when any contribution is unstated, because a partial sum passed off as a total is how budgets lie. Contributors with no stated number are listed, never zeroed. Ask for this when you want to know whether a declared limit or allowance is being exceeded — a budget for latency, mass, cost or any quantity — and which contributors take it over.

constraint_id.description: The Constraint (`con:…`) holding the limit to roll up against — one with a `quantity`, `limit` and `direction`, typically a KPP (`category: kpp`).

name: budget_report
